children.value: > Fact From Story: Despite a flurry of late attacks driven by Reece James, Ten Hag's team stood strong and held on to see out the victory.
> > Fact From Story: McTominay is now United's top scorer for the season with six goals, one ahead of Bruno Fernandes and Rasmus Hojlund.
> > > Fact From Story: United led for the majority of the first 45 minutes but failed to build on their lead and were pegged back by the former Manchester City man, Cole Palmer.
> > > Fact From Story: The Scotland international took one touch before blasting past Sanchez.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Having the game's top scorer contributes to winning a game.
> > Fact From Story: United have now won their past 19 Premier League games at Old Trafford when scoring first, including all 16 under their Dutch manager.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Scoring more goals than the other team leads to victory.
> Fact From Story: Manchester United got themselves back to winning ways thanks to a superb Scott McTominay brace against Chelsea.
> Commonsense Knowledge: When a team holds on to a lead to the end of a game, they win the game.
